# Deus Ex Machina Labs

> Small free browser games and makes from a home lab in the UK: Skywave, a daily ham radio propagation puzzle, Lorenz, a daily cipher machine puzzle, and 3D print designs for the radio bench.

## Home

- [Deus Ex Machina Labs](https://dexmlabs.app/): Homepage with the games and the makes.

## Games

- [Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/): A daily HF propagation puzzle on a 3D globe. Work ten made up stations in one UTC day. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [How to play Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/help.html): The rules of the daily Skywave puzzle.
- [Who made Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/about.html): Who made Skywave and why.
- [What's changed in Skywave](https://dexmlabs.app/skywave/log.html): The Skywave change log.
- [Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/): A daily puzzle on the Lorenz SZ40/42 cipher machine that Bletchley Park called Tunny. Set the twelve wheels and read the intercept. Free, no account, no cookies.
- [How to play Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/help.html): The rules of the daily Lorenz puzzle.
- [Why I built Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/about.html): Why I built Lorenz.
- [What's changed in Lorenz](https://dexmlabs.app/lorenz/log.html): The Lorenz change log.

## Makes

- [Lorenz chi wheel](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/lorenz-cipher-chi-wheel-demonstrator-simplified-sz42-teaching-model): 3D print of a simplified SZ42 chi wheel, for showing how Lorenz works. On Cults3D.
- [EFHW toroid box](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/tool/toroid-box-for-ft240-and-ft140-cores-efhw-49-1-9-1-unun-choke-so-239-n-or): 3D print for FT240 and FT140 cores. On Cults3D.
- [RF panel drill guide](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/tool/rf-connector-panel-drill-guides-so-239-n-4-hole-flange-and-bnc-d-hole-with): 3D print for SO-239, N and BNC holes. On Cults3D.
- [Band plan desk mat](https://arthurdeusexmachina-shop.fourthwall.com/products/uk-ham-radio-band-plan-desk-mat-160m-to-70cm): UK ham bands, 160m to 70cm. On Fourthwall.
- [Buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/arthurdeusexmachina): Support the lab.
